name: ovoz-promo-remotion
description: Ovoz promo reel rendered with Remotion from ../shared/build/timeline.json

scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts Promo ../out/remotion.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --crf=18 --concurrency=8 --overwrite
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts Promo preview/still.png
